confidence_notes: FX comes from an RBA search result showing 0.6720 USD per AUD on 18 Nov 2026. I did not open the RBA table directly. Food and drink anchors are based on one search of Numbeo-derived and MyLifeElsewhere aggregates: cappuccino about $5.8, draft beer about $8 for 0.5 L, inexpensive meal about $22-25, and two-person mid-range meal about $100-110. I found no reliable Boston cocktail or wine-by-the-glass average. Cocktail is estimated from the local relationship to beer, and wine glass is estimated from bar and restaurant norms. Accommodation figures are holistic estimates from general knowledge, with no listings checked and no accommodation searches. July is peak season in Boston, and hotel and hostel rates are volatile.
comparable_city_reasoning: Boston is a high-cost US Northeast city, priced similarly to New York and slightly below it for dining. Peak summer tourism and the limited supply of budget lodging push accommodation prices up.
